node.statement: Let A=C direct-sum C with its usual exact C*-algebra structure; then A is an extended epsilon-C*-algebra with epsilon=0. Fix 0<s<=1/2, set delta=s-s^2>0, and put P=Q=(1-s,s). Since P is Hermitian and P^2-P=(-delta,-delta), P and Q are delta-projections. Writing a=(1-s)^2 and b=s^2, associativity of this concrete algebra gives L_P R_P=R_P L_P=R with R(x,y)=(a x,b y), and at level two R_2(X,Y)=(a X,b Y) under M_2(A)=M_2(C) direct-sum M_2(C).
